js: (() => { const chip = [...document.querySelectorAll('#parts .part-chip')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'R2'); if (chip) chip.click(); const inp = document.querySelector('#inspector input.si'); if (inp) { inp.value = '22k'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } })()

(() => { const chip = [...document.querySelectorAll('#parts .part-chip')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'U1'); if (chip) chip.click(); const btn = document.querySelector('#inspector [data-act="math"]'); if (btn) btn.click(); })()

(() => { const v1 = [...document.querySelectorAll('#parts .part-chip')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'V1'); if (v1) v1.click(); const sel = document.querySelector('#inspector select'); if (sel) { sel.value = 'square'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } const freq = [...document.querySelectorAll('#inspector .field')].find(l => /Frequency/i.test(l.textContent))?.querySelector('input.si'); if (freq) { freq.value = '200'; freq.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } const ch1 = document.querySelector('#sel-ch1'); if (ch1) { ch1.value = 'in'; ch1.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } const tb = document.querySelector('#timebase'); if (tb && !tb.open) tb.open = true; const ts = document.querySelector('#in-tstop'); const dt = document.querySelector('#in-dt'); if (ts && dt) { ts.value = '20m'; ts.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); dt.value = '2u'; dt.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } })()
